messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>

Subject: Acme - Post-call: procurement path & trial-to-paid checklist

Hi John —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps so we keep momentum on the trial -> paid path: 

Call recap
- Trial scope: 30-day trial (100k tokens/month baseline) for the Acme customer support summarization pilot.
- Success criteria: 1) 80% accuracy on recall tests vs baseline, 2) sustained throughput at 200 qps for 90th percentile latency < 200ms, 3) integration of results into Zendesk macros.
- Reporting: weekly usage and quality snapshot from our Console; we'll auto-send to the distro below.

Procurement / commercial path options discussed
- Card: immediate start, self-serve billing (fastest, no PO).
- PO (paper): Acme procurement can issue a PO and we invoice monthly. Typical procurement timeline we see is 2–3 weeks for mid-market customers.
- Marketplace: AWS Marketplace listing available; if Acme wants procurement via contract through AWS/marketplace it can simplify purchase orders but adds ~1 week for listing/approval on your side.

Next steps
1) John to confirm preferred payment method (card vs PO vs AWS Marketplace) and share procurement contact.
2) If PO: we will send a short SOW + invoice details for your PO template (I attached the standard trial terms).
3) If card: we can start billing as soon as the trial moves to paid — we recommend selecting a billing start date aligned to your success criteria completion.
4) Rishi/Neha will follow up on commercial terms and provide usage thresholds that trigger billing recommendations.

Attachments: redwood-trial-terms.pdf (trial billing & conversion terms).

I'll ping next week if I don't hear back — feel free to reply with procurement contact or any additional questions.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from our side:
- Procurement prefers PO (we rarely put charges on a corporate card for this type of engagement).
- Our procurement lead is Karen Liu (cc'd). I'll also loop our finance contact if needed.
- Marketplace: we'd prefer to avoid adding another procurement path unless necessary. If PO is straight-forward that's our preference.

A couple questions before we start the PO process:
1) What billing start date do you recommend if the trial begins next week? Is billing immediate upon trial start or after we meet the success criteria?
2) Are there minimum usage thresholds that would automatically convert to paid? We may want to avoid an automatic conversion until after the evaluation period.

I've attached our PO template for reference (acme-PO-template.pdf).

Hi John / Karen —

Thanks for confirming the procurement route and for sharing the PO template. Answering your questions below and proposing a recommended path to keep things simple: 

1) Billing start date recommendation
- We typically recommend that billing begins only after you confirm the pilot met the mutually agreed success criteria (so you won't incur charges automatically at trial start unless you choose card billing). For PO-based purchases, we invoice monthly starting from the agreed billing start date.
- Suggested approach: start trial on Jul 1, evaluation runs Jul 1–Jul 31, and billing (if converted) begins Aug 1. If you'd prefer a shorter window we can adjust.

2) Minimum usage / auto-convert
- There is no forced automatic conversion tied solely to usage thresholds in our standard trial terms — conversion to paid requires explicit sign-off from your team (we can add an automated notification and a recommended conversion trigger, but we won't bill without authorization for PO customers).

3) PO paperwork & next steps
- I've attached a filled-in invoice details page and our standard SOW for trials (see redwood-trial-terms.pdf referenced by Marissa). Please let us know any redlines to the payment terms.
- If PO works: Karen, can you confirm the PO number once created and the contact who will sign? We will generate an invoice referencing your PO and the agreed billing start date.

Attachments mentioned: redwood-trial-terms.pdf (we already have this from Marissa) — I can send a separate signed SOW if you need it for your internal approvals.

Happy to join a quick call if procurement wants to walk through the flow.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com
